chapter: Louis Armstrong, King Oliver and St. Louis memories
title: Armstrong's reaction to Thomas's Just for a Thrill recording
summary: Babe relays what Lil Armstrong told her: Pops heard Joe's recording of Just for a Thrill and decided he now had to record it himself.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yeah. So I-get ... my little gig down at Chiles, run up to see Pops and ... for around an hour, which is a long time. So I told her about it. She said, Yeah, no kidding. Heard that. Yeah, Pops, I heard it. I think you're wonderful, man. It sure is clever ... He said, Well, why didn't you think say something about me?

No, I can't/that, man. that's Baby's.

It was one of the tunes you recorded called Just for Thrill and if I'm not mistaken it was Pops and Lil's tune and she had recorded all originals which Joe and made other people mak with her. But, she told me I'd come back to Chicago and gone home and ran into Lil on the street. And she said, Come on and go by the house with me. And I went by the house with her and she's telling me, I've got something I want to tell you that Pop did about Joe. So Joe and I were going together, we weren't married yet. she So she tells me that Pops came in town and was playing these records for him and she put on "Just for a Thrill." So she said he would never record it. So he sat there and he listened to it all the way through and at that time, evidently from the way she's telling me, he couldn't
remember Joe as a person. He didn't know him.

So, he said ... but he didn't know Joe so Lil said, he said to her, Who's that cat on trumpet playing my tune? So she said, That's Joe Thomas. He recorded all these tunes with me and he also recorded "Just for a Thrill." And she told me he said, Play it over. So she played it again. So she said when the record was over Pops was jubilant. He said, Wow, this cat can really blow and he's making me mad because now I'm going to have to go and really record this tune. I've got to record my own tune cause he's going to make me sound terrible. He's terrific, absolutely terrific. And, Lil couldn't wait, Lil hadn't seen Joe to tell him, she said I'm going to tell Joe when I see him but Babe, be sure to tell him. He really knocked Pops out doing this tune. And, Pops said he's going to have to record it cause I'm going to have to get this cat.
And, of course, it knocked us out.
